title: test(lint): give the LEDGER staleness comparison a standing non-vacuity proof
body:
Fixes #10913

`no ledger entry is stale` filtered `Object.keys(LEDGER)`, and `LEDGER` is empty by
design. `stale` was therefore `[]` for every possible corpus and every possible findings
set, and the case never consulted the sweep's output at all — so of the two corpus cases
in the file, one carried a standing non-vacuity proof and the other was green by
construction.

**Shape 1** of the two the card offered: the comparison is lifted into a pure function and
gets the treatment `the sweep can still fire` already gives the sweep.

- `staleLedgerEntries(ledgerKeys, findings)` — the real case calls it, and the new
  `the staleness comparison can still fire` calls **the same function**, not a
  re-implementation of it.
- `ledgerKey(finding)` — the `path::rule` shape was spelled inline in *both* corpus cases
  and had to keep agreeing; there is now one derivation, so the two readers cannot drift.
- The known-bad source is hoisted to `FIRING_SOURCE`, so both non-vacuity cases run on one
  fixture and the new case's "live" key comes from a **real finding** rather than a
  hand-written string — which matters, because `finding.path` is a `file:line`, not a file.

The new case asserts both directions in one call (`[live, dead] -> [dead]`). Each direction
alone is satisfiable by a degenerate comparison: returning `[]` unconditionally passes the
"live entry is not stale" half, and returning the ledger unchanged passes the "dead entry
is stale" half.

Why the file, and not this PR body: the card's own complaint is that the existing proof
lives in a PR body and decays. The reasoning is therefore written into the header (a
fourth false green) and into the `LEDGER` docblock, whose claim that "the non-vacuity
proof is the `the sweep can still fire` case" was true of the sweep and did not reach this
case.

## Verification

At `99f2d510`.

Both degenerate implementations of the comparison red the new case **alone** — and leave
`no ledger entry is stale` green, which is the vacuity the card describes:

| mutation of `staleLedgerEntries` | result |
| --- | --- |
| `return []` | `1 failed \| 4 passed` — only the new case |
| `return [...ledgerKeys]` (never consults findings) | `1 failed \| 4 passed` — only the new case |

The card's own ablation was re-run rather than inherited: planting one `LEDGER` key that no
live finding produces reds `no ledger entry is stale` alone (`1 failed | 3 passed`) with
the intended message.

- `pnpm lint` (full repo, `eslint . --no-inline-config`) — exit 0
- `pnpm check:type-check-debt` — OK, 33 entries re-measured, none above its recorded
  number; `@objectstack/lint` holds at 16
- 12 further derived gate families green (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`)
